text.title: Reef shark
text.nearby: A reef shark swims nearby, slow and calm.
text.chasing: A reef shark is after you! Hide in the corals!
text.bite: A reef shark bit you! Swim for cover!
text.menu_sub: Swim over the warm reef, look for small fish, rest in shallow water.
text.menu_wild: Nothing on the reef hunts a big reef shark.
text.intro: Up and Down to swim deeper. Swim slowly over the reef to look for food!
text.safe_tag: Tag, you got it! In Safe mode a reef shark never goes hungry.
text.hungry: You are hungry. Swim slowly over the reef and look for food!
text.no_food: No food here. Swim to another part of the reef.
text.about_looks: Grey-brown on top and white below, with black tips on all fins and a white band along the side.
text.about_food: Small fish, squid, octopus and shrimp.
text.about_home: Lives in warm shallow water near coral. Pups rest in calm lagoons and among mangrove roots.
text.about_winter: Stays active all year. The water stays warm, so it keeps swimming and eating.
text.about_young: Pups are born live in shallow water. Two to five pups are born at a time and swim on their own.
text.about_fact: Each fin has a black tip. The first back fin has a black tip edged in white.
